description:
Unit: U6
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u6-normalize-the-numbered-example-lane

Outcome
The numbered public lesson order stays stable while example support modules, loaders, and links use final names and paths.

Requirements and decisions
R2, R4, R8, R10-R13; KTD1-KTD3, KTD6, KTD8.

Affected surfaces
test/examples/**; examples/**; shared example support under test/support; test/examples/catalog.yml; and current README links.

Implementation direction
Keep the numbered directory and catalog structure. Rename executable modules to production Jido.* owners and shared fixtures to Jido.Test.*. Update lane-local loaders and common runtime support. Preserve :example and :peer together on both peer examples. Keep repeated code when it is necessary for standalone teaching value, and record any deletion under KTD6.

Acceptance
The catalog resolves every numbered lesson and current link. Examples stay out of the default suite and run through test.examples. Both peer cases run through test.peer and remain example lessons. Standalone lessons use documented support and no old module name.

Verification
mix test.examples --warnings-as-errors
mix test.peer --warnings-as-errors
mix test test/examples/catalog_test.exs --seed 0
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
The catalog, examples, and peer cases pass with original lesson order and final helper names, and U7 can start.
title: U6 Normalize the numbered example lane
